Fixture: 53_vardct_mixed_gray_128x128_filters_d4.jxl
128x128 greyscale, VarDCT lossy, default restoration filters, d=4.0

Purpose
-------
Same source as 50/51/52; filters at cjxl's default, coarser distance (d=4.0).
Completes the 2x2 filters x distance matrix for the greyscale source. See
50's sidecar for the source recipe and general rationale.

Filters left at default, so per 18181-3 Annex A Table A.1:

    Part 3 error class:  peak <= 0.06,  RMSE <= 0.02   (with filters)

cjxl/djxl are used strictly as BLACK BOXES: they emit/consume conformant
streams for JPXL to parse. libjxl's source is never read. If a rebuild at a
different libjxl revision changes these digests, that is the point of
recording them -- do not silently update them; note the revision change.
